en: Guide Master
Truck
Welcome! From today
column5: 欢迎！从今天起，你也是名出色的矿工了。

kr: 먼저 지하로 내려가 가볍게 돌부터 캐보시죠.
en: First
cn: go underground and try mining some stones.
column5: 首先，下到地下试着开采一些石头吧。

en: Great job! Here is the promised reward.
cn: 辛苦了！这是答应过的报酬。

en: Shopkeeper
Miner

kr: 어서 와. 여기가 네 첫 현장이야.
en: Welcome. This is your first site.
cn: 欢迎。这就是你的第一个工地。

en: Is there really anything down there?
cn: 这下面真的能挖到东西吗？

en: It does. If you know how to dig.
Got it. I'll head down first.
Got your pickaxe? Watch your stamina.
cn: 镐子带了吧？先注意体力。

en: What happens if it runs out?
The climb back up gets very long.
Don't scare me... I'll be careful.

kr: 오늘 캔 건 여기다 넘기면 돼.
en: Sell whatever you dug up here.
cn: 今天挖到的东西可以卖给我。

en: You'll give me a fair price, right?

kr: 나는 정직해. 시세가 정직하지 않을 뿐이지.
en: I'm honest. The market isn't.
cn: 我很诚实，只是行情不诚实。

en: ...Let me sell them anyway.
Got some gold? Fix up your gear first.

kr: 어떤 걸 먼저 올리는 게 좋아요?
en: What should I upgrade first?
Want to dig deep? Start with the mining license.
cn: 想挖得深就先弄采矿执照。

en: A license... even miners need paperwork.

kr: 장비가 슬슬 한계지? 손볼 때가 됐어.
en: Your gear's near its limit. Time for a tune-up.
cn: 装备快到极限了吧？该保养了。

en: The repair bill won’t be cheap.

kr: 구리 한 덩이만 가져와. 그럼 봐주지.
en: Bring me one lump of copper and I’ll cut you a deal.
cn: 带一块铜来，我给你便宜点。

en: Copper. That’d be a floor down.

kr: 구리는 좀 더 깊은 데 묻혀 있어.
en: Copper sits a little deeper.
I haven’t found a single lump yet.

kr: 서두르지 마. 밤이 되기 전에만 올라와.
en: No rush. Just come up before nightfall.
Back alive again

kr: 팔 것도 있고 살 것도 있어요.
en: I’ve got things to sell and things to buy.
cn: 我有东西要卖，也有东西要买。

en: Is today the day...? The day I'm supposed to work.
cn: 就是今天吗……？说好要打工的日子。

en: I should head outside first.
You the one who reached out?
cn: 你就是联系我的那个人吗？

en: ...Hello.

kr: 요즘에 이렇게 돈을 벌고 싶다는 사람이 흔치는 않은데 말이야. 여기로 와보게.
en: Not many folks looking to make money this way nowadays. Come on over here.
cn: 最近想赚这种钱的人可不多见了，过来吧。

en: First
This is..?

kr: 삽이네 보면 모르나. 이제 이걸로 광물을 캐서 가져오면 내가 값을 쳐줌세.
en: It's a shovel
cn: can't you tell? Mine some minerals with this and bring them to me
column5: and I'll pay you for them.
column6: 是铲子啊，看不出来吗。用这个挖些矿物带回来，我会按价收购的。

kr: 아 그리고 왼쪽에 구덩이가 있으니 거기서 파면 딱 좋을것같구먼.
en: Oh and there's a pit on the left  so it'd be perfect to start digging there.
cn: 啊 还有左边有个坑，在那儿挖正合适

en: Good work. How was it underground?
cn: 哦，辛苦了。地下感觉怎么样？

en: .....It was tough.
Haha
column5: 呵呵，赚钱本来就不是件容易的事。

kr: 아무튼 고생했네. 캐온 광물을 보여주겠나? 값을 매겨주지.
en: Anyway
cn: good job. Show me the minerals you mined
column6: 总之辛苦了。把你挖到的矿石给我看看吧？我来给你估个价。

kr: 앞으로도 잘 부탁하네. 피곤할텐데 좀 쉬지 그러나?
en: I look forward to working with you. You must be tired
cn: why don't you get some rest?
column5: 以后也请多关照。你一定很累了吧，去休息一下吧？

en: ...Yes. I think I need some rest.
